'''Scranton Toon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] working for the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], [[Plook Hartar]]. He was known to be arrogant and extremely skilled. He lost his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] in a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] crash and had it replaced with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] enhancement. He flew a [[Shock Hauler 33]] named the ''[[Goonga Munt Goonga]]''.<ref name="Bounties" />

Harter and his rival, [[Servid Norn]], devised a race to pit their best pilots against each other in order to determine whose pirate gang had the best pilots in their employ. Norn posted a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Toon to prevent him from participating in the race, thus ensuring his pilot won. The bounty required a live capture so as to not damage any working relationship his organization had with Harter's gang.<ref name="Bounties" />
